itemized.escalation_note: No cell was doubtful: the filing is written in heavy blue ballpoint and every figure resolved at the 200 dpi full-page read, and all three printed anchors agree to the cent on both sides, so no escalation was raised to settle a value. The four geometry-proof crops are recorded in the frames' measure_notes, not counted here. One incidental note on those crops: the p4 row-4 --value box clips the second raised cent digit at the right edge (it renders '$54 4' with the second '4' cut), because that filer writes his raised cents further right than the printed amount rule extends; the full-page read shows '$54 44' and the arithmetic closes uniquely at 54.44 (2038.13 - 500 - 682.19 - 801.50), so ARITHMETIC CLOSURE settles it and no wider crop was needed. ⛔ The Utah County filing fee on Schedule B row 2 is 682.19, matching the 2014-Surveyor row of the §F5 table; per §E1/§F5 it is NOT used to corroborate anything on this or any other filing — it is recorded only as an observation.

itemized.notes:
PAGE-FACE candidate 'GARY RATCLIFFE', party 'REPUBLICAN', Office Seeking 'SURVEYOR', residence city Springville, Utah — index.csv names NO candidate for this row (the 2008-2018 listing grouped by office), so the page face fills an empty channel label; the filename spelling 'Ratcliffe' agrees with the page face (no clerk name-drift here). 4 PDF pages: p1 cover, p2 SUMMARY PAGE, p3 SCHEDULE A, p4 SCHEDULE B — each classified from its own printed header. FOLIATION: the filer numbers his sheets 'Page 1 of 3', '2 of 3', '3 of 3', EXCLUDING the cover from both numerator and denominator — a further practice for the running foliation tally, and here it affirmatively says the document is complete as filed (3 numbered sheets, 3 present). Report type: 'Seven days preceding the Primary Election' checked with a hand-drawn X; the amendment question is answered 'No' (checked). Cover signature date 6/17/14, and the Date-of-Report box on p2/p3/p4 also reads 6/17/14 — no intra-document date discrepancy. No clerk received stamp is printed on this copy.

MIXED-TEMPLATE FILING — the SECOND in this chunk, which is worth flagging as a possible NORM rather than an exception for the June-2014 wave. The p1 COVER is the common 2014 blank titled '2014 FINANCIAL CAMPAIGN REPORT FOR COUNTY & LOCAL SCHOOL BOARD CANDIDATES (Utah County Code 2-5 & Utah State Code 17-16-6.5)', while pp2-4 are the COUNTY-ONLY inner sheets: the address heading reads 'Mailing Address & Zip Code' (not 'Address, City & Zip') and SCHEDULE B reuses 'Name of Contributor' over the vendor column with no Purpose column — the full 2012-era tell of §D2. Unlike the other Tracy/Acheson specimens these inner sheets carry NO '2014 County Candidate' corner label at all. ADDENDUM E §E2 records that Ratcliffe `6d40e35d`'s schedules are the plain 2014 blanks on both pages; THIS Ratcliffe filing is a different key and its headings were read on the page as §E2 instructs — same filer, same cycle, different schedule stock, which is exactly §F6's 'stocked INDEPENDENTLY' property.

STRUCK-THROUGH CORRECTIONS, retained under the handwritten-corrections-govern rule: the filer first entered '-0-' at line 1 Column A and Column B and a slashed zero at Schedule A's 'Subtotal for this page', then struck each out and wrote 2,038.13 above it. All three corrected figures agree with each other and with the four transcribed rows. The nil marks that were NOT corrected — '-0-' at line 3 and line 7 — are dashed-zero glyphs and transcribe as 0 under the zero-glyph ruling (a slashed or dashed ZERO is a numeral; a bare dash would not be).

STRUCTURE OF THE FILING: every contribution is a same-dated self-funding transfer from the candidate that pays a same-dated expenditure, so the two sides carry the identical four amounts and the campaign begins and ends the period at zero. The four expenditures are a political-consulting contract, the county filing fee, printing, and informational fliers.

PRIVACY: this filing was published UNREDACTED — it is not a `*_Redacted.pdf` and carries zero redaction bars on any of its four pages, so the candidate's own street address, phone number, and every donor/vendor street line are fully visible on the page. Per §A5 the reduction is applied at READ TIME: contribution rows carry donor city/state only, expenditure rows carry no address field at all, and NO street line, suite number or phone number has been written into this record — not into a field, not into a note. Row 3's payee attribution is stated as 'the same street and city as row 1' rather than by quoting the address.
